lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible on the mid-lateral flank, arranged in approximately five discernible vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular blobs, particularly evident in the mid-section of the visible flank, creating a lattice-like visual structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear features on the upper third of the flank exhibit a sharp vertical intensity gradient, with higher luminance values on the dorsal aspect of the ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface displays a dense, irregularly spaced population of small, high-luminance pixel clusters, distinct from the grid-like arrangement of the flank.
